scope: Android 15/API 35 AOSP AVD: visibility of the microphone foreground-service notification with POST_NOTIFICATIONS granted, and launch of MainActivity from its tap action.

source.note: The notification and service implementation were unchanged from the source-bound commit; a manual ADB tap caused the existing Flutter lifecycle integration test to observe an early resume.

preconditions.record_audio: Granted by the existing AVD QA runner.
preconditions.post_notifications: Set to granted with adb after app installation and before the foreground service started; the Android permission prompt and explicit user choice were not exercised.

notification_visibility.title: BOOHTACORD — голосовой сеанс
notification_visibility.body: Голос и микрофон активны. Откройте приложение для управления.

notification_tap.action: ADB tap inside the visible notification card.
notification_tap.failure_reason: The test expected the runner's scheduled control status 'resume', but the notification tap resumed the app while the control file still had status 'ready'.

raw_local_artifacts.retention: Screenshots and raw .out results/logs remain local runtime artifacts and are not committed.

limitations: This is an API 35 AOSP AVD result, not physical-device acceptance.
The permission was granted with adb; the Android consent prompt path was not tested.
The integration test aborted on the early notification-driven resume, so same-room recovery and receiver RTP after tapping remain unverified.
RTP from the separate 120-second baseline run is transport evidence only and does not prove acoustic audibility or intelligibility.
Android API 33/34, logout/revoke/listener-only exact-once cleanup, permission-revoke rejoin, iOS, physical audio routing and release gates remain open.
